models._comment: Per-role model tier: opus | sonnet for every judgement role; haiku is allowed for integrator ONLY (haiku 5.5, ADR-035, revisited for haiku 5.5). `ac config set models.integrator sonnet` opts out. Switch all at once with `ac models max|balanced|fast`. Remove a role to inherit the session model.

reasoning._comment: Per-role REASONING depth: low | medium | high | xhigh | max. Independent of the model tier above — both move cost, so `ac models max|balanced|fast` sets the pair together. NOT the same as a phase's `effort` (ADR-022), which budgets verify→remediate cycles. Remove a role to inherit the host default.
